question: The 2026-10-03 pure-Fabric server A/B, rerun with the same 165 jars after the seven Forbric-only defects it found were fixed.
inputs: Identical to reports/2026-10-03-pure-fabric-server (manifest.json and closure.json there; byte-identical, so not copied). Native results are the 2026-10-03 native sessions, reused because the native launcher digest is the same (f1d2bafd...); the native arm of the packs whose composition changed was run again.

kernel.source: origin/main 6d1dd0f2 plus the block-item link fix (branch claude/fix-block-item-link)

carrierBuild: built by tools/dev.py prepare --no-assets from that tree's pins (mc=26.2 forge=26.2-65.0.1 neoforge=26.2.0.88). The 2026-10-03 run used an older merged base; current main's kernel tables are derived from the base its own tools build, so the old base cannot stand in for it.

result.pack (all 130, 165 jars): both FAILED_TO_START; native first dies on beilin-data-portability (built for 1.21.x), Forbric's policy stop names only the both-fail subjects

sevenFrom20261003: notenoughcrashes, debugify, EnhancedVisuals (CreativeCore), ViaVersion (ViaFabric), moreladders, MoogsEndStructures (MoogsStructureLib), meowantixray: all MATCHED_PASS now (fixes on main 2026-10-05).

regressionFoundOnTheWay.run: per-mod and packs on origin/main 6d1dd0f2 itself (kernel a926743b... built on the same fresh base), 2026-10-10
regressionFoundOnTheWay.result: 125 MATCHED_PASS, 4 BOTH_FAIL, 1 FORBRIC_ONLY: naturalist-2.0.6-fabric-26.2.jar, MATCHED_PASS on 2026-10-03
regressionFoundOnTheWay.cause: merge-tool commit cdeef45d made the merged Items family MinecraftForge's, whose registerItem leaves block->item linking to the item registry's add-callback; that callback filled a map the merged (NeoForge) Item.BY_BLOCK is not, so Block.asItem() was AIR until the registration window closed, after the Fabric main entrypoints. naturalist's Hippo.<clinit> builds Ingredient.of(Blocks.MELON.asItem()) in its main entrypoint.
regressionFoundOnTheWay.fix: MinecraftForge's live block_to_item map is Item.BY_BLOCK itself (BlockItemLinkInjector), as on MinecraftForge; -Dforbric.blockItemLinks=off restores main.

scope: Server side only; no client, multiplayer join or rendering.
